## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` passes (if a widget or the sandbox changed)
- [ ] Changeset added for every app with a user-facing change (`pnpm changeset`), with an English and a Dutch line
- [ ] New logic is test-first (a failing test before the code that makes it pass)
- [ ] New or changed settings and texts are translated in `en` and `nl`
